facts.activity_file: benching, battering and shoring an excavation

control_failures.control_label: inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: high potential incident - gravity exposure at EX-9101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control GROUND_CONDITION_INSPECTION: the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SLOPE_MONITORING_RESPONSE: the response to slope monitoring alarms had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the response to slope monitoring alarms on EX-9101 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in designing and controlling excavations, specifically benching, battering and shoring an excavation. EX-9101 (earthmoving fleet) is in service for loading and dozing. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 28 October 2023 a high potential incident was recorded on EX-9101 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during start-up after maintenance; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
